questions.stem: Diffusion is the movement of particles from:
questions.answer: High to low concentration

questions.stem: Does diffusion require energy?

options.B: No, it is a passive process

questions.answer: No, it is a passive process

questions.stem: In the lungs, O₂ diffuses from:
questions.answer: Alveoli to blood

questions.stem: What makes alveoli efficient for diffusion?

options.B: Large surface area, thin walls, rich blood supply
options.D: They are connected to the heart

questions.answer: Large surface area, thin walls, rich blood supply

questions.stem: Diffusion rate increases if:
questions.answer: Surface area increases

questions.stem: When diffusion equilibrium is reached:

options.B: Net movement stops but particles still move randomly
options.C: All particles move to one side

questions.answer: Net movement stops but particles still move randomly

questions.stem: Glucose absorbed in the small intestine enters the blood by:

options.B: Diffusion (from high conc. in gut to blood)

questions.answer: Diffusion (from high conc. in gut to blood)

questions.stem: Fick's Law states that diffusion rate is proportional to:

options.B: Surface area × concentration difference / membrane thickness

questions.answer: Surface area × concentration difference / membrane thickness

questions.stem: Why does CO₂ diffuse from cells into the blood?

options.A: Blood has more CO₂ than cells
options.B: Cells have more CO₂ (from respiration) than blood

questions.answer: Cells have more CO₂ (from respiration) than blood

questions.stem: The smell of cooking reaches all parts of a house. This is:

options.C: Diffusion of scent particles through air

questions.answer: Diffusion of scent particles through air

questions.stem: What is the basic unit of life?
questions.answer: The cell

questions.stem: Which organelle is responsible for energy production in cells?
questions.answer: Mitochondria

questions.stem: What is photosynthesis?

options.A: The process by which plants make food using sunlight
options.B: The breakdown of glucose for energy
options.C: The absorption of minerals from soil

questions.answer: The process by which plants make food using sunlight

questions.stem: What is osmosis?

options.A: Movement of water from high to low water potential through a semi-permeable membrane

questions.answer: Movement of water from high to low water potential through a semi-permeable membrane

questions.stem: What molecule carries genetic information?
questions.answer: DNA (Deoxyribonucleic acid)

questions.stem: What is the function of chloroplasts?
questions.answer: Site of photosynthesis

questions.stem: In genetics, what is a dominant allele?

options.A: One that is expressed even when only one copy is present
options.B: One that is only expressed when two copies are present

questions.answer: One that is expressed even when only one copy is present

questions.stem: What is diffusion?

options.A: Movement of particles from high to low concentration without energy

questions.answer: Movement of particles from high to low concentration without energy

questions.stem: Which blood component carries oxygen?
questions.answer: Red blood cells (haemoglobin)

questions.stem: What is the role of the nucleus?

options.A: Controls cell activities and contains DNA

questions.answer: Controls cell activities and contains DNA
